DLR.reason: Docklands Light Railway: Minor delays between Woolwich Arsenal and Bank due to an earlier faulty train at London City Airport. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Elizabeth line.reason: No service between Paddington and Reading / Heathrow Terminals and SEVERE DELAYS on the rest of the line due to a late finish of engineering work. London Underground, Great Western Railway and South Western Railway are accepting tickets via any reasonable route.

Tram.reason: London Trams: Saturday 3 until Wednesday 7 October, no eastbound service Wandle Park - Centrale and westbound service Church Street - Wandle Park. Also no service between Arena and Elmers End on Sunday 4 October
